svg.text: XIAO ESP32-C5 meter on a breadboard: display wiring
Top view, column 1 on the left, row a at the bottom. Buttons not fitted yet (dashed). RGB LED not shown.
covers rows a to f and runs off the bottom edge
buttons (later): D0, D1, D4, D5 (row a) to the − rail
The XIAO's pins are in rows g (5V side) and c (D0 side); the TFT's header is in row f, pin 1 (VCC) in column 29.
Its pins join rows f-j of their columns: the wires go into row j, the pull-up into row i, above the module.
The TFT runs on 3V3 only: leave the XIAO's 5V pad unconnected. Fit an antenna on the U.FL socket before scanning.
LED straight from D9 works if the module switches its backlight (a few mA); otherwise use a transistor (BOM).
